config.execution: decide at close of bar d -> fill at open of bar d+1 -> hold to the next fill
config.cash: cash held at the start of a bar earns that bar's repo carry (ladder3 = GC007/GC014/GC028 equal rungs, exchange commission charged, panel from scripts/update_repo.py); --carry=0 reproduces the zero-carry book

defect.what: pre-r1268 marks averaged the book's per-name returns unweighted, so a vol-targeted book still moved the whole nav: the reported `cash` field was de-levered while the return path was not
defect.card_basis_gap_note: the open_to_open_equity curve sits on a basis shifted by one bar (it fills at the open of the bar whose close decided the book), so it is NOT an equality referee for a next-open accrual; the selftest instead pins r_scaled == s * r_unscaled against the engine-exact unscaled curve
defect.escape: the r1267 equivalence leg compared with vol_target=None, where every weight is 1/12

note: fixed_carry is the config the forward ledger now accrues. The uplift is carry on money the vol target had already parked, not alpha.
